assumptions.torque_speed_shape: full torque to half no-load speed, linear to zero (run_env assumption, not datasheet)
assumptions.rms_source: rev2_r3_ck7M 8-run max load^2 (sim continuous = 0.4 x class peak)
assumptions.rated_torque_caveat: RobStride rated torque is measured with a specified heat sink; mounted in a leg it can be lower

units.tau_*_out_Nm: N·m at the joint (knee: at the four-bar crank)
units.j_rotor_reflected_out_kgm2: module output-side equivalent inertia x external ratio^2 (kg m^2)
units.peak_ratio_vs_sim: combo peak / simulated actuator peak at the same joint (>= 1 reproduces the sim limit)

RS02.note: rated 6 N·m in manual, 7 N·m in brochure; mass 380/405/418 g across documents; I in A peak (Apk), kt per A rms

RS03.note: rated 20 N·m at 100 rpm with a 215x220 mm heat sink; no-load 195 (brochure) / 200 (manual) rpm, 195 used; mass 880-928 g; winding protection 145 C (manual: actual limit 180 C)

RS04.note: rated 40 N·m with a 345x345 mm heat sink (35 N·m with 220x200 mm); mass 1420-1510 g

RS06.note: rated 11 N·m at 100 rpm with a 130x160 mm heat sink; kt 1.09 (manual) / 1.1 (brochure)

AK10-9 V3.0 KV60.note: kt 0.16 N·m/A motor side x 9 (derived); rotor 1002 g cm^2 assumed motor side (x81 = output); the sim class B (48 N·m) is the older AK10-9 rating

AK80-9 V3.0 KV100.note: no-load speed not found (rated 390 rpm); rotor inertia 579 vs 1118 g cm^2 conflict

GO-M8010-6.note: rated torque not published -> thermal check impossible

DM-J8009-2EC.note: rated voltage 24 V; 320 rpm is the 48 V figure
